content:
emma: Heads-up — prepping telemetry + golden signals for marketplace metering before the SI onboarding next month. Need quick agreement on what metrics we must have, where to surface dashboards, and alert thresholds. Can folks chime in with both infra and partner-facing needs?

raj: Nice. At a minimum we should track: ingestion rate (events/sec), processing lag (P50/P95/P99), late arrivals (% of events > 1h), duplicate detection rate, entitlement mismatch count, reconciliation drift (reported vs billed) per-partner, and credit/negative-balance incidents. Also per-tenant QPS and per-region shard backlog.

liam: For infra: do we want instrumentation at the edge (partner webhook receiver) and post-processor (aggregator)? I think both — edge for late/invalid payloads, aggregator for reconciliation drift. We can reuse the existing meter-ingest topic tags but will need extra fields: partner_id, region, source_timestamp, event_id, schema_version.

sarah: Billing note — reconciliation drift needs a deterministic calc. Suggest storing two numbers on daily rollups: reported_units and billed_units, then drift_pct = (reported - billed) / max(billed, 1). For alerts, start with drift_pct > 1.5% sustained for 3 hours for high-volume partners. Also we need sample payload schema and a small example for SI teams.

sarah: Example sample event (send this to partners):
```json
{
  "partner_id": "partner_acme",
  "event_id": "evt_20260301_0001",
  "source_timestamp": "2026-03-01T12:34:56Z",
  "usage": { "tokens": 124, "type": "generation" },
  "schema_version": "v2",
  "signature": "base64sig..."
}
```

olga: Partner-facing: partners will ask for an SLA table. We should publish: expected reporting latency (15m ingest SLA, 95th <= 5m), guaranteed window for corrections (48h backfill), and escalation path. Also a partner checklist: sample events, quick replay tool, test harness, and sandbox dashboard access.

integration-bot: CI:deploy meter-pipeline -> staging succeeded (build #7823). e2e: 37/37 tests passed.

raj: Dashboards I'd add: per-partner overview (daily reported vs billed, drift sparkline), realtime ingestion health (events/sec, error rate), late-arrival heatmap by hour-of-day, and a reconciliation backlog queue gauge. Alerts proposal:
- reconciliation_drift > 2% for 1h -> severity P2
- late_arrival_rate > 0.5% (rolling 1h) -> P3
- duplicate_rate > 0.2% (rolling 1h) -> P3
- ingest_error_rate spike > 1% -> P1 (pager)

liam: Tech impl notes: we'll add tags to Kafka topics and expose metrics to Prometheus. For heavy partners (top 20 by volume) we should maintain per-partner rollup tables to avoid heavy cardinality in realtime dashboards. I'll prototype the exporter this week.

emma: Quick org tasks:
- raj: draft dashboard wireframes + alert rules (due Tue 03/09)
- liam: prototype prometheus exporter + per-partner rollup approach (due Fri 03/12)
- sarah: publish sample payload + reconciliation calc doc and threshold rationale (due Tue 03/09)
- olga: partner readiness checklist and SLA doc, coordinate comms with SI partners (due Wed 03/10)

emma: Also let's schedule a 30m sync with SI leads next Thu to walk through the test harness and golden signals. If anybody can't make it, drop blockers here and we'll handle async. :calendar:

olga: sgtm. I'll start drafting partner email and attach the sample event.

raj: I'll take ownership of the reconciliation alert rule.

liam: I'll add feature flag for the exporter so we can roll to staging first.

emma: Great — thanks everyone. If anyone thinks we missed a critical metric, call it out now. Otherwise I'll create an async doc and link it here in an hour. :thumbsup:
